assignmentEstimate.definition: A developer accepts a lawful assignment and cash received exceeds all unreimbursed option, diligence, legal and transaction costs, before income tax.
assumptions: Seller grants a clearly defined, assignable 365-day option plus a 365-day extension at the proposed price/fees. This has not been agreed.
Title/access, lawful use and net buildable layout are acceptable; exact land identity is resolved before signing.
A credible utility and two-route fiber delivery path fits a funded developer’s requirements and economics.
A funded buyer is found in time and seller/financing restrictions permit assignment.
assignmentEstimate.why: 61.77-acre tract on the Ontario industrial growth edge with a comparatively low land basis.
assignmentEstimate.downside: Agricultural zoning, irrigation rights and farm lease; industrial rezone and utility extensions are unproved.
assignmentEstimate.meaning: A rough working estimate and judgment range, not an observed success rate or statistical confidence interval. The chance of first persuading the seller to grant this option is excluded; today’s unconditional chance cannot be established.
